name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: Modal dialogs on UI SDK: Dialog, a card with a header, a scrolling body and footer actions that becomes a draggable tray in a compact container (presentation="auto"), with views that morph its height and travel in the direction of the flow (view, DialogView, DialogBack); AlertDialog, the centered iOS alert that waits for an answer; and the surface recipes the kit's other modal surfaces share.
